class.name: MovementBackend
class.brief_description: Decides when a movement simulation runs, and how many times.
class.description: This is the seam client prediction plugs into, and it exists now for one reason: it cannot be added afterwards. A component that ticks itself has the number of steps per frame baked into it, and replaying three inputs after a server correction means exactly that number changing. Splitting it costs one small class and saves rewriting every [MovementMode] later. [StandaloneMovementBackend] runs one step per physics frame and nothing else. A predicted backend would implement the same handful of methods, call [method CharacterMovementComponent.simulate] once per unacknowledged input after a correction, and answer [method should_resim] with true - without a single line changing in any movement mode.

method.name: get_sim_frame
method.description: How many simulation steps this backend has run.

method.name: is_fixed_dt
method.description: Whether every step is the same length. False means a mode cannot assume its delta, which matters to anything integrating by hand.

method.name: should_resim
method.description: Whether this backend ever replays a step it has already run.
